Ruling: batch #194 item 3 · letter A · maintainer 「同意」 2026-09-20T10:02Z

Director seat, summon #25, `session_012GcsUbuqFGBibkEDMRC1eE`. Presented in detail with the recommendation **A**; the maintainer agreed 「同意」. Thread re-read (no comments) in the act that wrote this.

## Ruling — **A**: the gate becomes REQUIRED at its first green

`Spec Main Shape Gate` becomes a required check in the window that opens at its **first `success` on objectui `main`** — a machine-readable trigger, ⛔ not 「objectui#9943 closes」, because the day-one break may be cleared from the objectstack side. In that window, as one act in two places: the maintainer enrols the context in ruleset `11776024`; the `domain:ui` seat moves the name from `NOT_A_GATE` to `REQUIRED_CONTEXTS` in `scripts/dependabot-merge-gate.mjs`. Before opening that PR the seat measures what the script does when the name is in `REQUIRED_CONTEXTS` and the ruleset does not list it (the card's unmeasured point) and orders the two steps so no half-state is observable. **B refused** (a permanently red check teaches everyone to merge on red — objectui#6596's measured lesson); **C refused** (declared-but-not-enforced is the shape this repository's enforce-or-remove channel exists to end). The schedule question stays as the card disposed it (no schedule for now, revisit trigger named).

Four-facet reading (this seat's own): ① contract drift costs rise monotonically and nothing says so at PR time today; ② the pull is objectui#9943 / #9944, both queued; ③ an AI change that names a spec member already moved goes green today and explodes at the next pin bump — a required gate moves that to 「this PR does not merge」; ④ one action, two places, the `merge_group` leg already in place.

`Prior rulings read:` objectui#9860 ruling C (the gate's origin), thread: none.

## Execution, same stroke

Reading taken in this act: objectui#9943 is already `closed`, so the day-one break may be cleared. `needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue`; `priority:p2` · `domain:ui` stand. The claiming seat's first act is to read the gate's latest conclusion on objectui `main`: if `success`, it opens the `REQUIRED_CONTEXTS` PR and moves this card to `pm:awaiting-maintainer` with the line `Maintainer-action: enrol "Spec Main Shape Gate" in ruleset 11776024 — done when the ruleset lists it`, merging in the same window; if still red, the card goes `pm:blocked` with `Blocked-by:` naming the card that clears it (objectstack-side if the fix lands there). The card closes when both the ruleset entry and the `REQUIRED_CONTEXTS` change are in place.

**Ruling — maintainer, 2026-09-20T14:48Z: option A.** Recorded by the `domain:ui#2` execution seat. ⛔ Not this seat's adjudication.

Verbatim:

> objectui#9584 + #9969 A

⇒ **A — enrol the context when the day-one break clears, ⛔ not before and ⛔ not never.** The maintainer writes the branch-protection entry (ruleset `11776024`); the seat moves the name from `NOT_A_GATE` to `REQUIRED_CONTEXTS` in `scripts/dependabot-merge-gate.mjs` in the same window.

⛔ Not B (enrol now, and red every objectui PR until the break clears). ⛔ Not C (leave it permanently advisory — the shape objectui#6596 already proved teaches everyone to ignore red).

## Execution

This card goes `pm:blocked` with `Blocked-by: #9943` — the day-one break. ⭐ A mechanism exists to release it: objectui's unlock scan fires when #9943 closes, which is what makes this a legitimate `pm:blocked` rather than a hold with no exit.

⚠️ **Half of A is not a seat action and never will be.** The branch-protection entry is a repository setting no file in this tree can write. ⇒ when #9943 closes, this seat's move is to prepare the one-line source change and **say so**; the enrolment itself waits on the maintainer, and ⛔ the seat does not report the gate as required until the setting is read back.

## ⚠️ One residual this ruling does NOT settle, and it is an ordering question rather than a re-litigation

**PR #9584** replaces the required test contexts (one `Test` aggregator in place of four shards, shards 4 → 8, dist pins split out). That PR is `clean` and not draft today.

⇒ if it lands **before** the new aggregator is registered, branch protection is left requiring contexts that no longer report, and nothing can merge. If it lands **after**, the old shard contexts are required while the PR that produces them is still unmerged.

⭐ **This seat does not guess the order.** The ruling answers 「when does the gate become required」 (A: at the break's clearing) and is silent on 「which side of #9584's landing the registration sits on」 — a different question that was not on the card. ⇒ carried as an explicit residual, ⛔ not filled in by inference, and ⛔ not a reason to hold anything else.

⚠️ The two are related but not the same: #9969 is about `Spec Main Shape Gate`; #9584 is about the `Test` aggregator. Both need a repository setting, and the ruling covers the posture for both — the ORDER for #9584 is the open half.

⚠️ **Correction to the `Blocked-by:` this seat wrote one minute ago — it was a half-state the moment it landed.** Written at 2026-09-20T14:49Z.

## What happened

The ruling's condition is 「enrol when the day-one break clears」, and this seat wrote `Blocked-by: #9943` to carry it. ⛔ **objectui#9943 is already CLOSED (`completed`).** A `Blocked-by:` pointing at a closed card releases on the next unlock scan and, until then, reads as a live hold that nothing is actually waiting for. ⭐ That is precisely the shape this seat spent the shift clearing off other cards.

## And the condition is not merely 「the card closed」 — it is MEASURED clear

⭐ Read in this act, on PR #9877's refreshed head `6d714173e`:

```
Spec Main Shape Gate — completed: success
34 checks, 0 pending, 0 failed
```

⇒ the gate the ruling is about is **GREEN**, against a real compile of objectui over objectstack `main`. ⛔ Not inferred from a closed card — read off the check run.

## Corrected state

`pm:blocked` → **`pm:awaiting-maintainer`**, and the `Blocked-by:` line is struck.

`Maintainer-action:` enrol `Spec Main Shape Gate` as a required context in ruleset `11776024`. The seat's half — moving the name from `NOT_A_GATE` to `REQUIRED_CONTEXTS` in `scripts/dependabot-merge-gate.mjs` — is dispatched in the same window and is ⛔ not started before the setting is read back, because a source file claiming a gate is required while branch protection disagrees is worse than either state alone.

⭐ `pm:awaiting-maintainer` is the honest state here: the decision is made, the condition is met, and what remains is one action outside GitHub's API surface that ⛔ no seat can take. ⚠️ It has **no machine exit by construction** — that is what the state is for, and it is why it carries the `Maintainer-action:` line rather than a `Restart-when:`.

## Branch-protection read-back at 2026-09-20T16:17Z — ONE of the two enrolments is DONE, the other is not

The seat's half of ruling **A** on this card — moving `Spec Main Shape Gate` from `NOT_A_GATE` to `REQUIRED_CONTEXTS` in `scripts/dependabot-merge-gate.mjs` — is gated on ⛔ never writing it before the branch-protection setting is read back. This is that read-back, taken from the ruleset itself rather than from a PR's check list.

`GET /repos/objectstack-ai/objectui/rulesets/11776024` — `name: main`, `enforcement: active`. Its `required_status_checks` rule carries **6** contexts, enumerated uncapped:

```
Lint
Type Check
Build & E2E
Build Docs
Changeset Declaration
Test
```

### ✅ objectui#9584's enrolment is DONE

`Test` — the single aggregator that replaced the eight sharded contexts — **is** in the list. That maintainer action can be struck. ⭐ It also gives the merge-queue churn on objectui#10099 its first real control: those ejections all carried a `cancelled` `Test` shard among 37 successes and **zero failures**, which is exactly the shape a required context that never reports produces against the queue's `check_response_timeout`. ⛔ Still not a conclusion — seven of this lane's PRs are in the queue right now under the new single context, and whether they come out intact is the reading that settles it.

### ⛔ objectui#9969's enrolment is NOT done

`Spec Main Shape Gate` is **absent** from those six. The 6-vs-6 match above is the lit control for that absence: the same enumeration that found `Test` present found this one missing, so the zero is a reading and not a dead instrument.

⇒ **This card stays `pm:awaiting-maintainer`.** The seat writes nothing to `scripts/dependabot-merge-gate.mjs` until a later read-back shows the context enrolled. ⛔ Not a blocker on anything landing: PR objectui#9877 carries the gate green and is queued behind its siblings on its own merits.

`Maintainer-action:` enrol `Spec Main Shape Gate` as a required status check in ruleset `11776024` on `objectstack-ai/objectui`. Nothing in the tree can perform it.

### One more thing the same read settles, recorded so nobody re-derives it

The ruleset's merge-queue rule reads `merge_method: SQUASH`, with `grouping_strategy: ALLGREEN`, `max_entries_to_build: 5` and `max_entries_to_merge: 5`. ⇒ the squash is configured at the **ruleset** level, which is why a PR's `auto_merge.merge_method` reads back `merge` on this repo regardless of what was armed. ⛔ That field remains a bad instrument; the artefact (one parent, `(#N)` title suffix) remains the good one.
